observations.explanation: Page 2 lists eight distinct environments, including operating systems, databases, games, household tasks, and web interaction, supporting the claim of varied task coverage.
Page 14 reports 25 models and an aggregate score of 4.41 for GPT-4; the open-model scores are substantially lower. Page 15 also describes the performance gap between API-based and open-source models.

Page 14 defines the aggregate weighting using the reciprocal of each task’s average score across the tested models. Because that average depends on the tested roster, the stated concern about weights not transferring unchanged to a later roster is warranted.

Page 30 says automatic LTP evaluation can be more lenient than human evaluation for Single Game Accuracy and Query Relevance, especially for open-source models. This supports the qualified uncertainty about those metrics.
